snippet.title: 4th AMSCII Compo 2024 - Presentation of the entries
snippet.description:
All entries of the 4th AMSCII Compo 2024. The entries are with their title but without the names of the artists, so that the voting will be as fair as possible.

This year there was also a wild entry by Rayon Games. Don't forget to checkout the game when released in one week.

Information on the compo and on AMSCII:
http://logiker.com/AMSCII

Information on voting is on the homepage as well.

Used Music:

"Neon Laser Horizon" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
